The trial cannot speak to whether Dimebon engaged its intended targets (mitochondria, NMDA receptor, histamine receptor). 2. POPULATION EFFECTS: Subgroup findings are all safety-related (QTcF prolongation, urinary abnormalities, BP changes). No efficacy subgroup analyses were conducted. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This is a single-arm safety extension study with no control arm, no efficacy endpoint, and no historical benchmark for the safety rate. The trial was terminated, likely due to the failure of the parent B1451027 efficacy trial.
